name: Glyph of Warding
material: Incense and powdered diamond worth at least 200 gp, consumed
description: Inscribe a hidden glyph on a surface or object. When it triggers it either explodes for 5d8 damage in a 20-foot radius or releases a stored spell of 3rd level or lower.
at_higher_levels: Explosion damage rises by 1d8 per slot level above 3.
